title: Trust records (team artifact)
description: Links to the published age rating, privacy policy, support contact and rights records, checked by Live Service Trust. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).

version.description: Artifact schema version the producer wrote. Same major as x-version.

id.description: Template id, or owner for files the owner makes.

createdAt.description: UTC time the file was written.

synthetic.description: True for worked examples. Consumers never treat synthetic data as a measurement.

build.description: The build the items describe, when they describe one.

kind.description: age-rating, privacy-policy, support-contact, account-deletion or rights.

location.description: Relative path or published page id the owner approved.
